versions.content: If an element in the McSupportData is related to an element in the input configuration which is subject to variability with the latest binding time PreCompileTime or PostBuild the RTE Generator shall add a VariationPoint for such element. The PreBuild and PostBuild conditions of the VariationPoint shall correspond to the PreBuild and PostBuild conditions of the input element's conditions.
